description: A flat tabletop is in front of you with a blue sponge cloth and a small spray bottle nearby, and a pillow sits along the back edge. The left hand presses the left-hand object (the sponge cloth) against the surface and wipes it in short strokes across the center area, sliding slightly left and right, while the right hand holds the right-hand object (the spray bottle) upright and mostly steady beside the cleaning area, occasionally shifting it a little.
